questions.text: Who have you known the longest, and what keeps that one going when others faded?

What do people get wrong about you when they first meet you?

What's the best thing you've observed while people watching?

Do you trust people quickly or make them earn it? Where did that come from?

What's the best advice you've ever passed on to someone else?

What behaviour makes you quietly decide you won't be spending much more time with someone?
